title: Naturally Charred Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: A weeknight Argentinian dish featuring shoyu-koji and broiled to perfection, this recipe is gluten-free friendly and cooked in a claypot.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together shoyu-koji, olive oil, garlic, parsley, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Place the skewers in a claypot and broil for 10-12 minutes, or until charred and cooked to desired doneness.
Brush the skewers with lemon juice during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
